svg.text: Concatenated: shared states, one map per cell type
one model: the cell types are laid end to end
same state = same mark combination in both
Stacked: one map, states span cell types
a state can mean "enhancer in GM12878 only"
Both are run with ChromHMM; the difference is how the binarised files are arranged
(several cell types in one cellmarkfiletable = concatenated; BinarizeBam -stacked = stacked)
